readinessSummary: Sandbox integration is not ready. This loop is readiness-only and read-only. eBay Developer Account readiness is not confirmed. Sandbox application readiness is not confirmed. OAuth is not implemented. No credentials, tokens, endpoints, URLs, scopes or secrets are included. Official eBay documentation validation is required before implementation. Production remains blocked. Draft mapping, draft creation and publication remain blocked.

developerAccountReadiness.notes: Developer credentials identify the IMNOVA eBay app. The seller account must authorize the app later through OAuth; IMNOVA must never store seller passwords.

scopeValidationReadiness.notes: Scopes must be validated against official eBay documentation in a future loop before any OAuth implementation.

blockedWorkflows.reason: Credentials must not be added until secure environment and secret strategy are approved.
OAuth implementation requires official documentation validation and a dedicated future loop.
